title: WebOverlay: High-Throughput Vision-Only Distillation for Extreme Aspect-Ratio Web Overlay Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.41037v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Web overlays, such as cookie consent banners, newsletter prompts, and age gates, obstruct automated web crawlers and degrade downstream document representations. While proprietary multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can accurately identify overlays, their latency and inference cost preclude web-scale ingestion. Conversely, lightweight vision models struggle with full-page renderings characterized by extreme vertical aspect ratios, where standard isotropic resizing collapses critical text features and causes false positives. In this work, we present WebOverlay, a high-throughput vision-only detector trained via distillation from a frontier vision-language teacher. We establish a dynamic tiling strategy that partitions extreme aspect-ratio web renders into aspect-preserving patches with spatial overlap, coupled with an aspect-ratio-aware boundary adjudication mechanism to eliminate boundary artifacts. translated_title: WebOverlay：面向极端长宽比网页浮层检测的高吞吐量纯视觉蒸馏方法
translated_abstract: 网页浮层（如 Cookie 同意横幅、新闻通讯订阅提示和年龄验证门槛）会阻碍自动化网页爬虫并降低下游文档表示的质量。虽然专有多模态大语言模型（MLLM）能够准确识别浮层，但其延迟和推理成本使其无法应用于网页级规模的数据摄取。相反，轻量级视觉模型难以处理具有极端垂直长宽比的整页渲染图像——在这种情况下，标准的等向缩放会使关键文本特征坍缩并导致误报。在本工作中，我们提出了 WebOverlay，这是一个通过从前沿视觉-语言教师模型蒸馏训练而来的高吞吐量纯视觉检测器。我们建立了一种动态分块策略，将极端长宽比的网页渲染图划分为保持长宽比且具有空间重叠的图像块，并辅以长宽比感知的边界裁决机制以消除边界伪影。为了消除跨模态延迟[依赖]……（摘要不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出 WebOverlay，一种从前沿视觉-语言教师模型蒸馏而来的高吞吐量纯视觉检测器，通过动态保持长宽比的分块策略与长宽比感知的边界裁决机制，解决了极端长宽比网页截图中浮层检测的效率与准确性问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes WebOverlay, a high-throughput vision-only detector distilled from a frontier vision-language teacher, which combines dynamic aspect-ratio-preserving tiling with aspect-ratio-aware boundary adjudication to efficiently and accurately detect web overlays in extreme aspect-ratio page renderings.
